atten3.ptxt: Be sure to perform a function inspection after assembling the throttle body or removing and installing its components.

s2.ptxt: Remove the EFI fuse and ETC-S fuse at the same time, and connect the fuses after 60 seconds or more have elapsed.
After installing the throttle body to the vehicle, turn the IG ON without operating the accelerator pedal.

atten3.ptxt: If the accelerator pedal is operated, start over from (1).

s2.ptxt: Start the engine, and check that the check engine warning light is not illuminated and that the idle speed is within the standard when the A/C is turned ON → OFF after warm-up.

item.ptxt: Perform in the N or P position.

s2.ptxt: When the accelerator pedal is quickly depressed to near full open, check that the value of [ECU Data Monitor] - [Throttle Sensor No.1 Opening (THP1)] is 60% or more.
Perform a road test and check that there is nothing unusual.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Camshaft Oil Control Valve Assembly Operation

s2.ptxt: Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select [Active Test] - [VVT Control].
Check the idle speed for [Not Performed/Performed].

specitem.ptxt: Not performed (OCV OFF): Normal engine speed
Performed (OCV ON): Rough idle or engine stalls

s2.ptxt: Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select [Active Test] - [VVT Linear Drive Bank 1].
Fully advance the valve timing (+100%) and check the idle speed.

specitem.ptxt: Valve timing not advanced: Normal engine speed
Valve timing fully advanced: Rough idle or engine stalls

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Intake Air Flow Meter Sub-assembly Function

item.ptxt: Inspect the intake air flow meter sub-assembly according to the following procedure.
If both [ECU Data Monitor] - [F/B Learned Value Bank 1] and [Intake Air Amount] are outside the standard, replace the intake air flow meter sub-assembly.

s3.ptxt: With all accessory switches OFF, start the engine and warm it up until the coolant temperature reaches 75°C or more.
Drive at 50km/h or more for 3-5 minutes. (*1)

s2.ptxt: Air-fuel Ratio F/B Learned Value Inspection

s3.ptxt: Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select [ECU Data Monitor] - [F/B Learned Value Bank 1] and read the air-fuel ratio F/B learned value.

atten4.ptxt: If outside the standard, perform the following [Intake Air Amount Inspection].

item.ptxt: Inspect with the vehicle level and the engine stopped.
Do not extract exhaust from the exhaust tail pipe with an exhaust duct.

s3.ptxt: Turn the IG ON and wait for 30 seconds.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select [ECU Data Monitor] - [Intake Air Amount] and read the intake air amount.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Accelerator Pedal Sensor Assembly Function

s3.ptxt: Turn the IG ON with the engine stopped.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select [ECU Data Monitor] - [Accelerator Sensor No.1 Voltage (VPA1)] and check the voltage with the accelerator fully closed.
Turn the IG ON with the engine stopped.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, select [ECU Data Monitor] - [Throttle Sensor No.1 Opening (THPS)] and check the opening.

entry.ptxt: Accelerator pedal fully closed → fully open

s2.ptxt: Accelerator Pedal Sensor Output Voltage Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the voltage between each terminal from the vehicle side connector.
